Just Sold | Northridge ✨

Sometimes the right home isn’t out there waiting for you… it’s already the place you’re living in.

Our buyer had been a longtime tenant at this property and set out this year with one clear goal—becoming a homeowner. We explored the market together, reviewed every option, and kept searching for “the one.” But nothing ever quite felt right.

Because deep down, it already was right.

Instead of waiting for the perfect listing to appear, we took a different approach. We reached out directly to the seller—who wasn’t initially planning to sell—and opened a conversation that changed everything.

With the right offer and the right timing, we were able to create a win-win solution that never required the home to hit the market. No open houses. No showings. No stress of competition. Just a thoughtful, private transaction that worked for both sides.

And just like that, a tenant became a homeowner in the place they already called home.

This is what happens when strategy meets intention—and when real estate becomes personal.

Congratulations to our buyer on this incredible milestone 🥂

items.caption:
toddlerchella was not on my 2026 bingo card, but here we are lol

we’ve been to coachella so many times over the years, and somewhere along the way it kind of lost its magic for us.

too hot, too dusty, too many people there just to say they were there.

so coming back this year was really just for laarni’s birthday. and when my mom got sick two days before the festival, bringing JJ with us ended up being the easier option.

what i didn’t expect was for it to turn into one of my favorite festival experiences we’ve ever had.

music festivals have always been such a big part of me and farrice’s story. even when i was pregnant, JJ was already along for the ride, going to five multi day festivals in the womb, and another before he even turned one. so getting to share this part of our world with him felt really special. 

it was JJchella in real life, and he was such a little rockstar all weekend. dancing all day and sleeping all night.

and somehow, ironically, it was coachella of all places that gave that back to us.

the desert always calls us back… 
and this time, i think it healed something in me too 🥹🥰

items.caption:
If you’re a first-time home buyer in California and the down payment is what’s been holding you back… read this.

The California Dream For All program is back — and when it opens, funds don’t last long.

Here’s what you need to know:

• Offers significant down payment assistance (up to 20% of the purchase price)
• For qualified first-time home buyers within income limits
• Structured as a shared appreciation program (repayment when you sell or refinance)
• Requires a homebuyer education course
• Funds are limited and distributed on a first-come basis

For many buyers in Los Angeles and the San Fernando Valley, it’s not about affordability long-term — it’s about getting through the front door.

If buying a home in 2026 is on your vision board, don’t wait until the funds are gone to start asking questions.

Send me a message and we’ll see if this program makes sense for you. 🏡✨
